headline: ManiLife's ads are drifting into dairy butter and supermarket searches, and a reseller is charging £11.99 for a jar you sell at £5.95 elsewhere.

points.title: Deep Roast Crunchy and Original Roast Smooth: cut ads on butter, hummus and Morrisons searches
points.detail: Both best-sellers show sponsored on searches for other products: "butter" (173,000 a month, organic #64), "morrisons" (46,000), "hummus" (17,000), "margarine" and "garlic butter". Negatives on these free budget for peanut butter searches.
evidence: Also sponsored on spread, cashew butter, garlic butter, anchor butter, president butter

points.title: Original Roast Smooth: a reseller holds the Buy Box at £11.99
points.detail: On the Original Roast Smooth jar (~£18,000 a month) the Buy Box is held by NBR TRAD£RS at £11.99, above the £9.00 list price, with 11 sellers, while the sister jars sell through Amazon at £5.95. Worth checking supply to Amazon and Brand Registry protection.
evidence: B0BCQCKK12: Buy Box owner NBR TRAD£RS, 11 sellers, price £11.99 vs list £9.00 (Keepa)
Deep Roast Crunchy B0BCQ91KNW: £5.95 via Amazon
Family revenue ~£18,380/mo (Jungle Scout estimate); Keepa sees ~£3,570, consistent with lost sales

points.title: Go after Pip & Nut shoppers on price
points.detail: Pip & Nut leads share of voice across your searches (16% vs ManiLife's 6%), and "pip and nut" (9,000 searches a month) has ManiLife at #22 with no ads near the top. At £5.95 against a £7.38 page-one median, the price makes the case for you.
evidence: Share of voice: Pip & Nut 15.8%, Morrisons 12.2%, Nutella 9.0%, ManiLife 5.9% (Jungle Scout)
pip and nut: 8,994 searches/mo, organic #22, no sponsored rank
Median page-one price: ManiLife £5.95 vs competitors £7.38

points.title: Deep Roast Crunchy: add a seventh gallery image
points.detail: The best-seller has 6 gallery images, one short of what shoppers swipe through on a phone. A comparison image (protein and ingredients against the big brands) would do the most work.
evidence: Family revenue ~£28,536/mo, 4,796 units, 4.4★ from 638 reviews (Jungle Scout estimate)

hero_actions.B0BCQ91KNW: Negate butter, hummus, margarine and Morrisons searches; add a 7th image.
hero_actions.B0BCQCKK12: Win the Buy Box back from the reseller before spending on ads.

content_note: Listings are strong on mobile (scores 92–100). The only gap is 6 images on the Deep Roast Crunchy gallery.
ad_strategy_summary: Ads already cover about half of the top 30 searches and ManiLife is #1 sponsored on "peanut butter". The job is pruning: cut the butter, spread and supermarket searches, and test Pip & Nut and Whole Earth searches with the price advantage. Indicative budget is small (~£550/mo on the gaps).
amc_hypotheses: 75% of the live range offers Subscribe & Save in a consumable category, so in this category repeat buyers typically drive most revenue.
amc_questions: How many ManiLife buyers reorder, and after how many days?
Which flavour do new customers start with, and what do they buy next?
What share of ad-driven sales are new to the brand?
